# Pin map and sleep-leakage table (generated by check_netlist.py --write; do not edit by hand)

Requirements: NFR-01 (3 months), NFR-12 (whole-board deep sleep <= 50 uA, design target 25 uA). Matches design.py; `firmware/main/board.h` does not exist yet, Mira must copy this table.

## Deep-sleep leakage paths (battery terminal, USB unplugged)

| Path | typ uA | worst uA | Source / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| ESP32-C3 deep sleep, RTC timer + RTC memory | 5 | 10 | datasheet read (series v2.4 Table 5-9); module flash leakage worst = assumption |
| XC6220B331 LDO quiescent (U2) | 8 | 10 | XC6220 datasheet: 8 uA typ (PS mode), 18 uA max; power budget assumed 2 uA typ: 6 uA worse |
| TP4056 BAT drain, USB unplugged (U3) | 3 | 6 | assumption (datasheet ~2-6 uA shutdown/standby, p.2 not re-read) |
| DW01A operating current (U4) | 3 | 6 | assumption (datasheet not read, ~3 uA typ) |
| 8205A leakage (Q1) | 0.05 | 1 | assumption (both FETs on, Vds ~0) |
| Battery divider R7+R8, Q2 off | 0 | 0.1 | Q2 AO3400A off-state leakage nA; if Q2 is on: 3.7 V / 2 MOhm = 1.85 uA (measure only) |
| AHT20 sleep (U5) | 0.25 | 1 | power budget value (AHT20 datasheet 2024-07: sleep <= 0.2 uA max) |
| BH1750 power-down (U6) | 0.01 | 1 | datasheet unverified; needs a power-down command before sleep |
| U7 soil gate, VCC = IO3 low | 0.1 | 1 | IO3 must be held low in deep sleep (RTC hold); leakage only |
| MLCC leakage C1-C14 (about 100 uF total on VBAT/3V3) | 0.1 | 1 | assumption (>= 100 Mohm insulation resistance class) |
| USBLC6 / LEDs / CC resistors, VBUS = 0 | 0 | 0.5 | no supply, only I/O leakage (USBLC6 datasheet not read) |
| Pull-ups R3-R5, R16, R13/R14, gate pull-down R6 | 0 | 0 | all nodes at the rail or GPIO low in sleep: no DC path (check: IO8/IO9/EN high, IO1 low) |
| **Sum** | **19.5** | **37.6** | NFR-12: limit 50, target 25 uA |

Typical vs target: 1.28x margin; worst vs limit: 1.33x margin. Most rows are assumptions (datasheets not read); the real number is the 5.2 / 4.P5 measurement.
